findings.original: English and French legislation run parallel and are identical in purport.
findings.rewrite: English and French legislation run parallel and have the same purpose.
findings.problem: "Identical in purport" means identical in content or substance; "have the same purpose" narrows it to aims and drops "identical".
findings.fix: English and French legislation run parallel and are identical in content.

notes_review: The logged calls are sound: keeping "James 1" as printed, keeping "master" in the guild setting, retranslating the French bracket of n6 literally, and adding the repeated "Chapelier goes on" tag all follow the bible.
summary: Fidelity is very high: every statute, penalty, date, sum and attribution survives, and the irony ("well-known straightforward fashion", "great Liberal party", "forsooth") is kept. The prose is plain and readable, though p009 is heavy with the §7 parentheticals the rules require.
